subtitle: Tracking Florida's 2026 property tax elimination proposals and related reforms
current_status_summary: The May 27, 2026 Florida Senate bill-actions page reviewed for this tracker listed multiple bill actions and did not show a tracked property-tax elimination proposal on that list. The bill-actions page displayed a notice that the Senate will convene on Friday, May 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m., or upon the call of the President. Earlier Florida Senate bill-actions notices reviewed for this tracker stated the Senate would convene on May 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM for Special Session E. CS/CS/HJR 203 passed the Florida House but died in Senate Appropriations during the regular session. The issue could return through a later special session or a new joint resolution.
